details:
Our project, Abandoned but not Forgotten, is an interactive storytelling game designed on Canva. It allows players to explore two destinations, the Moon and Mars, and discover NASA equipment that was left behind after completing its missions. Players choose where they want to go and learn about different machines, including the Apollo 15, 16, and 17 Lunar Rovers, Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity. Each section provides information about the equipment, its purpose, achievements, and what happened at the end of its mission.

The main benefit of our project is that it makes learning about space exploration more entertaining and accessible. Instead of simply reading facts, players interact with the presentation and choose their own exploration path. Our intended impact is to raise awareness about the technology and scientific discoveries that remain on the Moon and Mars, showing that even though these machines are no longer active, their contributions are still important.

We used Canva to design and develop the game, including interactive buttons, links, text, and visual elements. Our project is creative because it transforms scientific information into an exploration adventure where the player becomes part of the story. While developing it, our team considered the accuracy of the information, the simplicity of the explanations, the visual design, and how to make the experience engaging and easy to navigate. We wanted to create something educational that would inspire curiosity about space exploration and remind people that abandoned does not mean forgotten.
